name: Seville
tagline: Orange trees, flamenco and Moorish palaces
summary: See the Alcázar and cathedral early, rest through the hot afternoon, and come out again for tapas and flamenco. The old centre is flat and best on foot.
seasonNote: Summer regularly passes 40°C. Holy Week and the April Fair bring peak prices.
arrival: The airport bus reaches the centre in about 35 minutes; Santa Justa station has high-speed trains.
gettingAround: Walk; use the tram, bike share or taxis for longer hops.
cashTip: Cards are common; small bars may have a minimum spend.
foodTip: Order tapas a few at a time: salmorejo, spinach with chickpeas, fried fish and the pringá sandwich.
buyTip: Hand-painted ceramics from Triana, fans and olive oil.
baseArea: Santa Cruz, El Arenal or Alameda

connections.note: Air time only; the direct train takes about 5.5 hours.
Limited direct flights; buses take 6 to 7 hours.

items.name: Royal Alcázar of Seville
items.summary: A royal palace of Mudéjar courtyards, tilework and walled gardens, still in use.
items.expect: Timed tickets that sell out days ahead in spring.
items.tip: Book the first slot online and bring ID that matches the ticket.

items.tip: Book online; the Giralda's 35 ramps are easier than stairs.
